block=[n for n in new.body if isinstance(n,ast.If) and ast.unparse(n.test)=="__name__ == '__main__'"][0]
namespace=phase.__dict__.copy(); namespace['prepare']=lambda:None; namespace['run']=lambda:0
sys.argv=[str(runner),'--prepare-only','--output',str(phase.OUT)]
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=block.body,type_ignores=[]),str(runner),'exec'),namespace)
assert namespace['OUT']==phase.OUT and namespace['PREP']==phase.PREP
shell=(e/'outside-sandbox.sh').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
stage=shell.split('\nconflict-red-final-02)\n',1)[1].split('\n  ;;',1)[0]
